composition_mechanism: A top left-to-right provenance spine feeds a lower offline analysis arc; the evidence ledger and publication gates remain visually separate from computed outputs.
grayscale_encoding: Implemented flow uses solid connectors and dark borders; migrated flow uses double checks; unresolved publication gates use dashed connectors and lock marks, so status does not depend on hue.
